data.name: Rear Window Replacement Sydney
data.description: Mobile rear window replacement across Sydney. We clear every fragment out of the car and make sure the demister grid works before we leave. Call 0423 018 888.

mainEntity.name: Why did my rear window shatter completely instead of cracking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because it is tempered rather than laminated. Tempering locks stress into the panel, and once the surface is broken anywhere that stress releases through the whole sheet at once. It fails into small blunt cubes by design, which is safer than long shards, but it does mean the entire panel is gone the moment it breaks.

mainEntity.name: Will my demister still work after the glass is replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will if the connections are done properly. The heating element is printed into the new panel already, so nothing is carried over from the old glass. What matters is that the connector tabs at each side are intact and fully seated. We test the grid with the demister running before we pack up, and check that it is heating across the whole window rather than one half.

mainEntity.name: Do you clean all the broken glass out of the car?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and it is a substantial part of the visit. We clear the aperture channel, release the rear seat base to reach the trap behind the cushion, check the seatbelt reel housings, and vacuum the parcel shelf, boot, wheel well and carpets, then vacuum again once the new panel is in.

mainEntity.name: Can a rear window be repaired instead of replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Chip and crack repair works on laminated glass, where the damage is contained in one layer. Tempered rear glass has no separate layer to work on and nothing intact left to bond to once it has gone. Replacement is the only option.

mainEntity.name: My rear window has a wiper and privacy tint, does that change anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: It changes which panel your car takes, so it affects sourcing more than fitting. Wiper cut-outs, factory privacy tint, aerial elements and brake light apertures are built into the glass and the replacement has to match. Send a photo from inside the car if you are not sure what yours has.

mainEntity.name: How soon can you get to me, and can you come to my workplace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turnaround depends mainly on the panel. Common models are often same day or next day, less common variants take as long as the glass takes to reach us. We come to homes, workplaces, street parking and car parks anywhere in Sydney, and we need room to open the boot or tailgate fully. Mention the building if the car is in a basement, so we can confirm access beforehand.
